## How it was checked

- [ ] Unit tests pass (`python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`) and the web tests pass (`for f in tests/*.cjs; do node "$f"; done`)
- [ ] A bug fix adds a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] No real repo names, personal paths or backup contents in the code, docs or this description
- [ ] The backup, upload-confirmation and loopback rules in [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/yogoldy/RepoHub/blob/main/AGENTS.md) are unchanged or strengthened
